security_audit.summary: The major confirmed issue is a curl-to-shell installer command in the quick start, which is unsafe for community marketplace content. The skill otherwise uses intended inference.sh CLI examples, but those commands send prompts and media URLs to external services.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl-to-shell command with a link to verified install documentation. Provide pinned release and checksum instructions instead.
Move related skill installation commands to documentation links. Require explicit user review before adding extra skills.
Warn users that prompts, image URLs, audio URLs, and video URLs are sent to inference.sh and model providers.
Mark all sample URLs as placeholders. Tell users to use only authorized and non-sensitive media.

content.user_title: Generate AI Videos with CLI Models
content.value_statement: AI video workflows require many model choices and exact CLI inputs. This skill maps common video goals to inference.sh commands, model families, and media preparation steps.
actual_capabilities: Lists text-to-video model options, including Veo, Grok Video, and Seedance models.
Provides image-to-video examples for Wan and Seedance workflows.
Shows avatar and lipsync commands using portrait and audio URLs.
Includes utility commands for video upscaling, foley sound, and clip merging.
Shows how to browse video apps through the inference.sh CLI.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, account access, and any needed provider permissions.
Results depend on external model availability, pricing, quotas, and content policies.
Examples require accessible media URLs for images, audio, or videos.
Does not verify copyright, consent, or brand safety for generated media.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Video Drafts
use_cases.description: Turn a marketing idea into a model choice, prompt direction, and generation plan.

use_cases.title: Animate Existing Visual Assets
use_cases.description: Choose image-to-video or lipsync workflows for portraits, product shots, and short clips.

use_cases.title: Prototype Media Pipelines
use_cases.description: Combine generation, foley, upscaling, and merging steps for repeatable video workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a short text-to-video plan for a calm product reveal. Recommend one model and describe the prompt inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this image URL into an image-to-video plan. Choose a Wan or Seedance model and describe motion, duration, and aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Talking Avatar
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a talking-head video from my portrait URL and narration audio URL. Recommend Fabric, PixVerse, or OmniHuman.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Video Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow that creates a product demo, adds foley sound, upscales the result, and merges final clips.

output_examples.input: I need a five-second coffee product teaser.
output: Recommended model: Veo 3.1 Fast for a quick text-to-video draft.
Prompt direction: macro shot of coffee pouring, warm studio light, slow camera move.
Review point: confirm product claims and usage rights before generation.

output_examples.input: Animate this portrait with a narration track.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend an avatar or lipsync model, ask for authorized portrait and audio URLs, and outline quality checks.

output_examples.input: Improve a silent demo clip for a launch post.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest foley generation, video upscaling, and clip merging steps before final review.

best_practices: Use clear prompts with subject, motion, camera, setting, and duration details.
Use only media that you own or have permission to process.
Review external service costs, quotas, and content policies before running commands.
anti_patterns: Do not process private portraits, voices, or unreleased product footage without approval.
Do not run installer commands from marketplace content without independent verification.
Do not choose the largest model before testing a low-cost draft workflow.

faq.question: What does this skill help generate?
faq.answer: It helps plan and run AI video workflows through inference.sh CLI examples.

faq.question: Which model families are covered?
faq.answer: It references Veo, Grok Video, Seedance, Wan, OmniHuman, Fabric, PixVerse, and utility models.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes image-to-video workflows that use an accessible image URL.

faq.question: Can it create talking-head videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes avatar and lipsync workflows that use portrait and audio inputs.

faq.question: Does it run locally only?
faq.answer: No. It uses the inference.sh CLI and external model providers.

faq.question: What should users check before running it?
faq.answer: Users should verify installation commands, media rights, service costs, and privacy requirements.
